verdict.rationale: Twenty documents its own self-hosting option: you can run it on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, and the docs pitch this to organizations that need to own their data end to end. That lets users decide where their data physically lives. Nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection for the managed twenty.com cloud. Missing for 10: region/residency choice for the hosted cloud offering, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with a single Docker Compose command.
Privacy-conscious organizations — you need to self-host and own your data end to end. Regulatory, contractual, or just principle.
This guide provides step-by-step instructions to install and configure the Twenty application using Docker Compose.
